create_safekey_wrapper: create a SafeKey wrapper around a JAX PRNG key to prevent double use
split_safekey: split a SafeKey into multiple new SafeKeys using jax.random.split
duplicate_safekey: duplicate a SafeKey into multiple copies that share the same underlying key
apply_safe_dropout: apply safe dropout to a tensor using a SafeKey with configurable rate and training mode
register_pytree_node: register SafeKey as a JAX pytree node for tree traversal and serialization
